required_review_dimensions.description: Local reference lease gate only; no real external credential/effect or authority widening.
Canonical Slice8 hashes, idempotency/result evidence and lineage validated before broker access.
Real accepted Slice8 output is exercised, not an invented schema.
Lease binding uses Slice8 completion-evidence binding_hash.
Tampered Slice8 result/completion/binding hashes fail before broker access.
Raw secrets are rejected and absent from governed records/evidence/diagnostics.
Lease scope cannot exceed terminal lineage or current profile policy.
Profile/lease freshness, epochs and revocations are enforced at use time.
Replay is non-amplifying; rebinding, stale refresh and forged handles fail closed.
Credential/handle possession cannot substitute for governed authority.
Recovery preserves bounded metadata without governed raw-secret persistence.
Future provider/profile handling remains data driven.
Red, false-green, defect-exposure, fixture-isolation and provider-capacity failures are preserved and correctly classified.
